mission.name: IDC Forge Cross-Harness Gauntlet
mission.tagline: One canonical forge, portable by proof rather than proclamation.
mission.northStar: Preserve the fifty-island source while every compatibility claim is falsifiable, tiered, and reproducible on the harness that consumes it.

policies.notes: Local branches and commits are permitted for isolation and recovery. No push, PR, release, or profile install without explicit user authority. The 400-line target is advisory for generated mission/report assets and test fixtures.

phases.title: Contract and red-capable tooling
phases.goal: Replace portability claims with a sourced harness contract, a repo-owned validator, and a Windows-native installer/exporter.

gates.title: Harness support matrix is valid JSON
gates.notes: Schema and source sufficiency also receive blind artifact critique.

gates.title: Validator and installer falsification tests pass
gates.notes: A green test suite is admitted only after representative fixtures are shown to force red.

gates.title: All canonical skills pass repo-owned validation
gates.notes: claude.ai exportability findings are profile results, not canonical failures.

tasks.title: Build authoritative cross-harness support contract
tasks.notes: Builder A owns docs/harness-support.md and docs/harness-support.json in an isolated worktree.

tasks.title: Build dependency-free whole-forge validator
tasks.notes: Builder B owns scripts/validate_skills.py and its falsification tests.

tasks.title: Build Windows-native installer and claude.ai exporter
tasks.notes: Builder C owns scripts/install.py and its falsification tests.

phases.title: Gauntlet critique and integration
phases.goal: Blind critics refute each artifact, builders repair surviving findings, and the integration branch receives only evidenced changes.

gates.title: Each builder artifact has a non-author critique record
gates.notes: Same-family independent critique; not a cross-family verdict. Verification script may be added during integration.

gates.title: Integrated regression suite passes
gates.notes: Must include canonical validation and installer/exporter tests.

tasks.title: Rotate blind critics across all three builder branches
tasks.notes: Critics receive the task bar and diff, not the builder's self-report.

tasks.title: Loop critical findings back to original builders
tasks.notes: Maximum two total rounds; unreachable bars become explicit blockers.

tasks.title: Integrate approved local commits and align canon/docs
tasks.notes: No remote write. Resolve overlap on the integration branch.

phases.title: Recursive fifty-island health sweep
phases.goal: Run the stricter contract over every island and keep only skill changes tied to concrete red cases.

gates.title: Canonical profile passes for all fifty islands
gates.notes: Warnings and unsupported export profiles remain visible in the evidence.

gates.title: Deterministic claude.ai exports validate without canonical drift
gates.notes: Exact CLI may be corrected after the installer interface is integrated.

tasks.title: Run whole-forge canonical and harness profile sweep
tasks.notes: Enumerate failures by skill name and invariant, never by count alone.

tasks.title: Repair only evidenced canonical defects
tasks.notes: A skill edit stays only if the same evaluation improves or holds with fewer tokens.

tasks.title: Update authoring and install documentation to the proved support matrix
tasks.notes: Remove broad dual-harness claims that exceed evidence.

phases.title: Fresh-clone reacceptance
phases.goal: Re-derive the final gates from a clean clone and publish an honest completion report.

gates.title: Fresh clone passes full test and validation suite
gates.notes: Gate script may be added during integration; evidence must name the exact reviewed SHA.

gates.title: Mission state and generated State of the Union agree

tasks.title: Commit the final integration tree at an exact SHA
tasks.notes: Local commit only unless the user later authorizes publication.

tasks.title: Clone the exact integration SHA and re-run every gate
tasks.notes: Worktree evidence is inadmissible until reproduced here.

tasks.title: Finalize report, risks, and resumable next actions
tasks.notes: Completion remains partial if a named harness lacks a verifiable loader.

metrics.label: Named harnesses with tier, source, and probe
claude.ai export failures from unsupported top-level keys

risks.title: No different-family reviewer is callable from this Codex session
risks.note: Gauntlet critiques can be blind and non-author, but cross-family-review remains blocked and no output will be labeled a cross-family verdict.

risks.title: Several requested harnesses may not expose a native Agent Skills loader
risks.note: The matrix must leave these documented-only or unknown rather than inventing installation paths.

risks.title: claude.ai allowlist currently comes from supplied external audit text
risks.note: Treat the six-key claim as supplied evidence until an authoritative public specification or direct upload probe is captured.

nextActions: Wait for builders A-C to commit their isolated artifacts, then record each exact commit in this state file.
Rotate blind critiques A->validator, B->installer, C->contract using only the task brief and branch diff, not builder self-reports.
Route critical findings to the original builder, cap at round 2, then cherry-pick surviving commits into codex/gauntlet-integration.
blockers: Cross-family verdict unavailable: this session can spawn only OpenAI-family sub-agents.
Remote publication is outside current authority; all branches and commits remain local.
conventions: ops/mission/state.json is the source of truth; never hand-edit state-of-the-union.html.
Positive harness claims require an authoritative source and reproducible probe.
Canonical skill bytes are preserved unless a red-capable evaluation justifies an edit.
Worktree evidence is draft evidence until re-derived from a fresh clone.
